'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Brady DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brady]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
